feed.scope: Fixed indexed pocket, axial centreline only. No rotation during entry.

discharge.scope: Fixed indexed upper pocket, axial centreline only. No dynamics.

transfers.name: upper-return to side-return
transfers.model: Ideal no-wall-hit projectile to approximate receiver ball-centre height, from isolated track rolling speed. Rims may intercept the ball; this is a screening bound, not proof of escape.

transfers.name: side-return to lower-return
transfers.model: Ideal no-wall-hit projectile to approximate receiver ball-centre height, from isolated track rolling speed. Rims may intercept the ball; this is a screening bound, not proof of escape.

return_funnel.scope: Straight continuation of final track seated centreline only.

slicing-checks.json.limitations: Generic slicing only. No printer-specific G-code published; support removal and physical tolerances remain untested.

path-checks.json.scope: Geometric seated-ball clearance in pocket and straight trough segments ONLY.
